Messages.Author: Cooper
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ, and others,

Someone plays Firebrand, and the vote passes. I was wondering, is
there a time window in which you can you use firebrand, before playing
a votercap?

thx!
W

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You can't cast the new extra vote from the Firebrand in the referendum that has
already been successful in placing the Firebrand, no.

Messages.Author: Cooper
Messages.Body:


Heh, that part i understood already, thx. votes have been cast
already.

What i meant was the other part of firebrand. Can i burn a blood to
untap an anarch, before playing votercap (thereby filling her up
completely again)

W

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Ah. That you can do, yes.

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:


Vampire x, x-1,x-2 and x-3 are all anarch
X calls RC. Can you use the firebrands tio untap all anrchs younger
that were tapped to allow mass untapping and retapping for the same
RC, or is it only usable to untap them for the second RC?

Firebrand
Type: Political Action
Requires: anarch
Requires an anarch.
If this referendum is successful, put this card on the acting anarch.
This anarch gets 1 additional vote during a political action. During
your minion phase, this anarch can burn 1 blood to untap a ready
younger anarch. Burn this card if this anarch goes to torpor. An
anarch may have only 1 Firebrand.

Fun, yes...but i dont think it is very viable.
You would need lots of small vamps to really make use of that. you
need lots of firebrands that are usable => many different capacities.
you need at least 2 barons (5+cap) to play it twice.

You would need a breed machine to do this i think,...and for breed-
machines there are easier ways to win, and this system is pretty
fragile.
W
